```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(ggformula)
library(glmmTMB)
library(ggeffects)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(mosaic)
library(tableone)
library(summarytools)
```

```{r}
# Load the dataset
health_survey_df <- read.csv("../health_survey_data.csv")

# Exclude the question row 
health_survey_df <- health_survey_df[-1, ]

head(health_survey_df)
```

```{r}
selected_health_survey_df <- health_survey_df |>
  # Gender, Age
  select(QID91, QID46)
```

```{r}
health_survey_df <- type.convert(health_survey_df, as.is = TRUE)
```

```{r}
health_survey_df 
```

```{r}
cont_vars <- c("QID46")
cat_vars <- c("QID91")
```

```{r}
desc_table <- CreateTableOne(vars = cont_vars, strata = "QID91", data = health_survey_df, factorVars = cat_vars)
print(desc_table)
```
